title: Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.31892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Block-causal video diffusion generates long videos block by block, conditioned on a persistent key-value (KV) cache. After each block is denoised, an extra noise-free ($t=0$) forward pass writes its clean KV into the cache; once distillation and speculative early exit make denoising cheap, this clean KV update dominates the runtime. Reusing stale KV shortens the update, but stale memory corrupts the conditioning of later blocks and inflates their denoising steps, so the saved compute reappears downstream. We present SAMR (Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction), a training-free method for frozen causal video DiTs that refreshes only part of the cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards. Our key observation is that, once rotary position phases are removed, motion-aligned historical KV and the in-flight KV a token holds at its exit step are complementary estimates of its clean KV. translated_title: 便宜的内存代价是未来的计算：协同设计持久KV缓存与GPU执行以实现高效流式视频扩散
translated_abstract: 块因果视频扩散通过逐块生成的方式生成长视频，并以持久化键值缓存作为条件。每个块去噪完成后，需要额外进行一次无噪声（t=0）的前向传播来将其干净的KV写入缓存；一旦蒸馏和推测性提前退出使去噪变得廉价，这种干净KV更新便成为运行时的主要开销。复用过期的KV可以缩短更新时间，但陈旧的缓存会破坏后续块的条件生成，并增加其去噪步数，因此节省的计算量会在下游重新出现。我们提出了SAMR（步骤感知记忆重建），这是一种面向冻结因果视频DiT的无需训练的方法，它只刷新部分缓存，并无需DiT前向传播即可重建其余部分。我们的关键观察是，在去除旋转位置相位后，运动对齐的历史KV与token在其退出步骤所持有的进行中KV是其干净KV的互补估计。SAMR使用离线校准的per（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了无需训练的SAMR方法，通过步骤感知记忆重建部分刷新KV缓存并无需DiT前向传播地重建其余部分，解决了流式视频扩散中干净KV更新成为主要运行时开销、而复用过期KV又会损害下游生成质量的核心矛盾。
en_tdlr: Proposes SAMR, a training-free method that partially refreshes the KV cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards, resolving the core tension in streaming video diffusion where clean KV updates dominate runtime while reusing stale KV degrades downstream generation quality.
